subtopic: Alternative Mutual Funds vs. Hedge Funds
source_evidence: However, alt funds differ from hedge funds in several important ways.
question: Misconception: Alternative mutual funds and hedge funds are essentially the same because they can use similar investments and strategies. Is that right?
answer: Not quite. Although they may use similar investments and strategies, alternative mutual funds are regulated as mutual funds and have safeguards such as limits on illiquid investments and borrowings, while hedge funds are not required to follow those regulations. They also differ in who can buy their shares: alternative mutual funds are open to any investor, whereas hedge funds are limited to accredited investors or qualified purchasers.
